title: anthriscus cerefolium var. longirostris
intro: Anthriscus cerefolium var. longirostris, commonly known as Long-Stemmed Chervil, is a plant species in the carrot family, known for its delicate, lacy foliage and long stems. The health benefits of Long-Stemmed Chervil include its ability to act as a natural digestive aid, helping to alleviate symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the digestive tract. Long-Stemmed Chervil contains a range of bioactive constituents, including essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
